column4: cleat#2195: this test is Postgres-only (sharding is a PostgreSQL configuration; no sharded MySQL/SQL Server topology exists), with no per-dialect subtest -- it skips as ONE bare test name, not a /postgres suffix, so the existing broad /postgres$ suffix lines in multi-db-ci-initial-measurement.tsv do not match it. multi-db/mysql sets only CLEAT_TEST_MYSQL, so this skips here.

cleat#2195: same test, same reason as the multi-db/mysql line above -- multi-db/mssql sets only CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL. Runs fine under cluster and test-go/engine (both set CLEAT_TEST_DB/postgres), so no pairing needed there.
